answer: Proof-of-stake protocols defend AI agent economies against Sybil attacks by requiring capital collateral. Like a single grove of trees in a vast tundra, an agent's influence is rooted in verifiable financial weight rather than ephemeral digital personas. Without significant stake, an attacker cannot produce a consensus sonnet of valid blocks. The cost of an attack is strictly tied to the devaluation of the attacker's own locked assets, rendering the creation of infinite fake identities economically irrational.
